fact: The Public Utilities Regulatory Authority (PURA) invited licensees, sector ministries, industry stakeholders, consumer groups, civil society organisations and the general public to comment on draft instruments including the Broadcasting and Online Content Regulations, 2026 and the Journalists Registration Guidelines, 2026, with a consultation window of 1 to 10 April 2026.

The Ministry of Trade (MOTIE) with the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy held a national validation workshop on the draft E-Commerce Policy and Strategy on 24 September 2025, attended by government and private institutions who reviewed the draft in groups and gave feedback.

PURA issued the draft Broadcasting and Online Content Regulations, 2026 for public consultation on 2 April 2026, one of seven draft instruments released together (date is that of PURA's consultation notice).

On 2-3 July 2025 a National Validation Workshop on the draft National Data Policy of The Gambia, with ministers of Information and of Communications and Digital Economy present, had stakeholders from government, the private sector, civil society and academia give inputs on data protection, cross-border data flows and institutional coordination (EEAS, 8 July 2025).

The regulator PURA, with WARDIP and the Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy, held a validation workshop at the African Princess Hotel where telecom executives, consultants and development partners reviewed its proposed regulatory tools (cost modelling, tariff benchmarking, pricing frameworks) for ex-ante telecom regulation, and PURA's director general called on stakeholders to contribute before it finalised the framework.

fact: The Gambia Public Procurement Authority held an external stakeholder validation of the draft e-Government Procurement Regulations on 9 May 2024; its director general says the draft was consulted on with public and private stakeholders.
The minister said the bill went through a multi-stakeholder consultation that engaged civil society, private organisations and local authorities, ending in a fourth draft.
